summary: Verified both changes end-to-end: (A) bug-fix admin login (trader@tradehub.io / trade1234) works, returns is_admin=true, /auth/me OK, invalid password → 401. (B) Full multi-tenancy: self-registration creates user + 6 default tags + token, duplicate → 400; new user workspace is completely EMPTY (analytics/overview total_trades=0, strategies=[], trades=[], alerts=[]); admin still sees the seeded 120 trades + 3 strategies. Cross-account isolation verified: neither account sees the other's strategies/trades; GET by id across accounts → 404. Admin user-management endpoints (GET/POST/DELETE /api/users) work: list includes trade_count/strategy_count/is_admin, admin can create/delete, deletion removes login + all owned data, admin deleting own id → 400. Non-admin calling /api/users endpoints → 403. Unauthenticated /api requests → 401. Webhook posting to a user's strategy creates an alert owned by that user; admin does NOT see it. Regression: full 43/43 pytest suite in /app/backend/tests/test_tradehub_api.py still passes serially (auto-trade toggled ON via session fixture, then reset). Frontend: Login page has switch-to-register/switch-to-login toggle + register-name field, registering logs in and lands on empty dashboard, non-admin has NO nav-users item, admin has nav-users, Users page lists users (trade_count/strategy_count columns), 'Add User' dialog (new-user-btn → user-name-input/user-email-input/user-password-input → save-user-btn) creates a user that shows up in the table, delete button removes non-self users (toast 'User deleted'), admin's own row shows 'You' with no delete button. All admin state reset at end (auto_trade OFF, broker disconnected, live=false) and all test users deleted.

design_issues.screen: Users page (and any page reached from login)
issues: The green 'Welcome back' toast is anchored top-right and its ~48px-tall container/pointer-events area overlaps the top-right PageHeader button (new-user-btn) for the first ~3s after navigation. Playwright page.click(force=True) still records as intercepted; dispatchEvent('click') works. A real user waiting for the toast to fade (or one who clicks below the toast) is unaffected. Recommend either shortening the toast auto-dismiss to ~1.5s, adding pointer-events:none on the toast wrapper, or reducing top offset so it does not cover PageHeader action buttons.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: give the sonner/toast wrapper pointer-events:none (or auto-dismiss < 2s) so it does not shadow PageHeader action buttons like new-user-btn during the first few seconds after navigation. Not a functional blocker — click still works via keyboard/normal usage — but it caused a spurious Playwright interception in automated tests until dispatchEvent was used.
critical_code_review_comments: seed() correctly re-syncs the admin password on every startup via update_one(...set: password_hash) when the stored hash doesn't verify against ADMIN_PASSWORD — this is the bug-fix promised in the request and matches auth playbook idempotent-admin pattern.

Every read/write in strategies, trades, alerts, notifications, tags, settings is scoped by {owner_id: user['id']} — no leaks were found. Cross-account by-id returns 404 (correct: 'not found for this owner', not 403 which would leak existence).
register() + admin create_user() both call seed_user_tags(uid) so a new workspace always starts with exactly 6 default tags — verified in test_register_creates_user_with_6_tags.
delete_user cascades across ['strategies','trades','alerts','notifications','tags','settings'] via delete_many({owner_id: uid}) — confirmed by trying to log back in as the deleted user (401).
delete_user guards against self-delete with 400 — verified.
Webhook /api/webhook/{token} correctly stamps owner_id from the strategy owner, so an alert created via a user's webhook lands only in that user's /api/alerts — verified.
server.py is now ~1070 lines. Same recurring feedback: consider splitting into routers/services. Not blocking.
